facts.value: Discover the diverse offerings for international students and researchers at Goethe University and shape your personal academic path.

Whether it's a semester abroad, ERASMUS study, internship, or work in research and teaching – a stay abroad opens up many new opportunities and perspectives for your personal and professional development.
Goethe University lives internationality: As an international university, it is globally connected and maintains many international university partnerships.
Internationality shapes our research, our study programs, and our campus. Therefore, all members of Goethe University are international – regardless of their origin.
